description: JS analysis against the installed layout: an unused dependency, a phantom import of a transitive dependency, a script that runs a binary of another package's dependency, and one that runs a workspace member's binary without listing the member.

pnpm.reason: pnpm links a member's binaries only into the packages that list it. With node-linker=hoisted the install does put e2e-tool on b's PATH, but skif does not read the linker (ADR 0097), so it is reported under both linkers.

yarn.reason: Yarn Berry runs only the binaries of a package's own dependencies, under every linker.

bun/default.reason: Bun installs a new workspace isolated (bun.lock configVersion 1), which links no member binary into b.

bun/isolated.reason: Bun's isolated linker links a member's binaries only into the packages that list it.
